cohort: 124 cases of EPH and 248 matched control patients at Helsinki University Central Hospital, Finland
finding: The incidence rate of EPH was 9.9/10,000, and risk factors included vaginal delivery with a history of cesarean section, prostaglandin-E1 induction, maternal age >35 years, previous curettage, and twin pregnancy.
mod_finding: Patients whose current delivery was vaginal and had a cesarean section (CS) in their history had a six-fold risk for EPH; women who underwent their first CS had a nine times higher risk, while patients who currently underwent CS and had a history of previous CS had a 22 times higher risk.
gest_age: Early gestation was identified as a risk factor for EPH, but specific gestational ages are not provided.
